personality_one_liner: A calm, hyper-functional workspace where tracking your career feels as natural and seamless as checking your messages.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and input fields must use safe spacing (minimum md inside, lg between) so the layout never feels cramped.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar.
Use on the sticky headers over scrolling content (e.g., Tracker tabs, Search header).
Use on the bottom-sheet drag handles and headers.
dont's: Avoid stacking more than two glass surfaces.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: A calm, frictionless entry point into the workspace.

states.loading: Subtle pulsing brand logo in center.
states.error: Standard error toast with retry on network failure.

screens.layout: Minimalist layout. Logo mark centered top. Below, a clean email input stack and primary Continue button. Below that, a subtle 'Continue with Google' button using the real Google logo PNG. Background should use the minimalist warm sand texture image with a heavy, light-tinted scrim over it to preserve readability.

screens.name: Job Search (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary discovery surface combining immediate search intent with browsing capabilities.

states.empty: Illustration of a magnifying glass + 'No jobs match your criteria' + 'Clear Filters' CTA.
states.error: Error message with 'Tap to retry' CTA.

screens.layout: Header features a large search input field (surfaceTertiary) and a glass filter button next to it. Below header, a horizontally scrolling carousel of quick filter pills (Remote, Design, $100k+). The main body is a stacked vertical list of Job Cards. Cards must have generous padding, utilizing real company logo PNGs, job title, metadata tags (location, salary), and a right-aligned subtle bookmark icon.

screens.name: Filter Bottom Sheet
screens.purpose: Deep filtering controls that stay contextually tied to the search screen.
screens.layout: Invoked from the search screen. Glass header with drag handle. Scrollable content containing segmented controls for Role, Location, and toggle switches for Remote/Onsite. A two-handle slider for Salary Range. A sticky primary CTA ('Show 142 Jobs') anchored to the bottom.

screens.name: Job Detail
screens.purpose: In-depth review of a job listing focusing on readability, ending with clear action steps.

states.error: Readable network error with retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen view. The hero features the company's real logo layered slightly over a blurred background tint derived from the logo color. Clean typography layout for the Job Description using the rich text/markdown. A sticky container at the bottom root (using glassmorphism) houses two CTAs side-by-side: a secondary 'Save to Tracker' button and a primary 'Apply' button.

screens.name: Application Tracker
screens.purpose: A mobile-optimized Kanban board allowing quick status overview and progression.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty folder + 'You haven't tracked any applications yet' + 'Find Jobs' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Instead of a cramped multi-column kanban, use a horizontal pager (tab view) grouped by status: 'Saved', 'Applied', 'Interviewing', 'Offer', 'Rejected'. The active tab is indicated by a segmented control rail sticky at the top. The body is a vertical scroll of application cards under that specific status. Cards show company logo, job title, date applied, and a visual reminder pill. Tapping a card opens a modal to move stages or add notes.

plant_leaf_accent.alt: Minimal plant leaf accent for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines. Strict adherence to generous spacing (md/lg inside and between cards) to maintain a premium feel.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple hues. The palette is strict: warm stone/sand base with Sage Green as the only accent color. All text should use near-black or dark gray.

Implement horizontal pager (swipeable views) for the Kanban tracker instead of vertical stacking or tiny dense columns. A segmented control should govern the active Kanban stage (Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Rejected).
Ensure 'Job Detail' and 'Filter Bottom Sheet' have sticky CTA containers at the bottom. Use expo-blur for these sticky bottom containers.
Whenever a list contains jobs, utilize real fetched company logo PNGs instead of fallback avatars or icons. I have provided sample Apple, Amazon, and Spotify images to use in the mock data.
All full-screen background images (like on the Auth screen) MUST feature a top-to-bottom three-stop linear gradient scrim to ensure text readability.
Avoid thick borders, heavy shadows, and completely centered pure-white layouts. Ensure the app looks highly functional but organic.
